x-values.network: the network itself: create, rename, note, retention, delete
x-values.location: a location: create, update, delete, assign devices
x-values.collector: attach a registered collector to the network
x-values.threat_exposure: EXPERIMENTAL: a threat exposure definition by name: create, update, delete, evaluate (start an analysis on a snapshot); enabled by the org property THREAT_EXPOSURE
x-values.asset_criticality: EXPERIMENTAL: assign or remove the criticality of named assets (what a threat exposure definition selects its critical assets by)

name.description: network create: the new name; cluster update and tag update or delete: the existing cluster or tag

definition.description: the body for the object and action; see Input details in `fwdctl run NAME --help`

confirm.description: network delete: the exact network_id; location delete: the location id; tag delete: the exact tag name; cluster delete: the exact cluster name; threat_exposure delete: the definition name; asset_criticality delete: the names joined by commas
